rooms.name: The Dripping Threshold
rooms.blurb: Lantern-light gutters on wet stone. Something small and half-forgotten skitters back into the moss.

rooms.name: The Sunken Reading-Room
rooms.blurb: Rows of swollen books moulder in the dark. A damp wraith drifts between the shelves, mouthing pages it can no longer read.

rooms.name: The Warded Door
rooms.blurb: A mossbound door, sealed by an old ward that will not open for the unprepared. Beyond it, the roots go quiet.

rooms.name: The Unnumbered Margin
rooms.blurb: The page-count fails here. Something with too many legs waits in the gutter where the numbering stopped, a shape that has forgotten its own name stands very still, and the dark between them hangs like a curtain nobody drew.

rooms.name: The Root-Heart Hollow
rooms.blurb: At the rotten heart of the old tree, the Moss-Warden waits — a great mossy sentinel grown tight around a single stolen truth.
